headline.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Files Prospectus Supplement for 6.500% Notes Due 2029
headline.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance 就 2029 年到期的 6.500% 票据提交招股说明书补充文件

summary.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement dated August 17, 2026 for an offering of 6.500% notes due 2029. The notes mature on October 15, 2029, with interest payable April 15 and October 15 beginning October 15, 2026. The offering is a further issuance of the 6.500% notes due 2029 issued on June 5, 2026.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. 于 2026 年 8 月 17 日提交了初步招股说明书补充文件，拟发行 2029 年到期的 6.500% 票据。该票据将于 2029 年 10 月 15 日到期，自 2026 年 10 月 15 日起，每年 4 月 15 日和 10 月 15 日支付利息。此次发行是 2026 年 6 月 5 日发行的 2029 年到期的 6.500% 票据的进一步发行。

headline.en: Partners Group closes $1bn private credit mandate with Asia investor
headline.zh: Partners Group与亚洲投资者完成10亿美元私募信贷委托

summary.en: Partners Group has closed a $1bn private credit mandate with a "major" institutional investor in Asia. The mandate includes a discretionary tranche managed by the firm as well as co-investment capital, under an open-ended evergreen structure.
summary.zh: Partners Group与一家亚洲的“大型”机构投资者完成了一笔10亿美元的私募信贷委托。该委托包括由该公司管理的全权委托部分以及共同投资资本，并采用开放式常青结构。

headline.en: Private credit consolidation continues through 2026, starting with CVC-Marathon deal
headline.zh: 私募信贷整合在2026年持续，以CVC收购Marathon开局

summary.en: Private credit market appetite for mergers and acquisitions continued in 2026 despite negative headlines about the asset class. The year began with CVC buying global credit manager Marathon for $1.2bn.
summary.zh: 尽管关于该资产类别前景的负面报道不断，私募信贷市场在2026年的并购意愿仍在延续。年初，CVC以12亿美元收购全球信贷管理公司Marathon。

headline.en: CPP Investments posts strongest quarter in over a decade on real assets and credit
headline.zh: CPP Investments 因实物资产和信贷业务录得十多年来最强季度业绩

summary.en: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board reported its strongest quarterly investment performance in more than a decade in the first quarter. Real assets, particularly energy, contributed meaningfully, while credit delivered steady gains.
summary.zh: Canada Pension Plan Investment Board 在第一季度公布了十多年来最强的季度投资业绩。实物资产，尤其是能源，贡献显著，而信贷则带来稳健收益。
